title: Product Manager, Study Lifecycle
description:
We are rebuilding biotech for the AI era.

When a breakthrough is delayed, the world waits. Getting a molecule from discovery to patients, or a crop from lab to field, involves thousands of slow, manual, disconnected steps. AI has the potential to change this, compressing decades of R&D work into years. But that only happens when clean, structured scientific data and AI are built into how science gets done.

Benchling is the AI platform for biotech R&D. Scientists use Benchling to design experiments, capture structured data, and run AI agents and models directly in their workflows. Over 200,000 scientists around the world trust Benchling to power their most important work, from academic labs to Sanofi, Moderna, and more than half of the world's top 50 biopharma.

We’re building an AI scientist for our customers. We can’t do that if we haven’t built the muscle ourselves. AI fluency is the foundation we build on; it's core to how we work, and we're committed to helping every new hire integrate it into their day-to-day. As part of our interview process, you'll complete a brief AI-focused exercise or discussion so we can understand how you think about and use AI to drive impact in your role. Feel free to reference any tools, platforms, or workflows you use today.

ROLE OVERVIEW

 Benchling's platform helps the world's largest biotech and pharma companies develop therapies faster. As a Product Manager on the Study Lifecycle team, you'll work on products such as Studies, Sample Testing, and Process Development that scientists use to do their jobs. These products are fundamental to how scientific work gets organized, planned, and connected to analysis across different phases of a drug's development cycle.

We launched Bioprocess in 2024 to help process development teams design, execute, and analyze the experiments that turn a molecule into a manufacturable drug. In 2025, we announced a partnership with Merck (press release https://www.prnewswire.com/news-releases/benchling-announces-collaboration-with-merck-on-vaccine-bioanalysis-302478378.html) to help their teams develop and test vaccines faster by bringing their analytical workflows onto a single platform.

Today, we're implementing the largest pharma companies in the world on Bioprocess, making the core product better every quarter, and expanding into Analytical Sciences and downstream QC. Our vision is to become the software that helps biopharmas bring therapies to patients twice as fast.

You'll be working at the intersection of experimental planning, execution data, and analysis, deciding how a single study ties them together around a scientific question. You'll figure out how to make powerful software feel intuitive to the scientists who depend on it every day, and dependable for the teams who integrate with it through our APIs.

You do not need a life sciences background. We're looking for a systems thinker with product taste who can walk into an unfamiliar domain, find the structural patterns, and be effective quickly. The best PMs we've seen for this kind of work have diverse backgrounds. They've built products across meaningfully different problem spaces and bring transferable instincts rather than a single industry playbook.

RESPONSIBILITIES

- You are responsible for Studies, Sample Testing, Process Development, and how experiment run data connects to analysis. That means you and your team decide what gets built, why, and in what order. You're accountable for the roadmap and the outcomes your roadmap produces, for scientists who use the product and for the customers and partners who integrate with it through our APIs.

- To inform what you build, you will spend time with customers and GTM teams to understand how scientists actually work, and how to turn what they ask for into what they need. It's your responsibility to bring that context back to the team and turn it into product direction.

title: Aerodynamics Expert (MSc. or PhD)
description:
Aerodynamics Expert (MSc. or PhD)
Pay: $80-$120/hour
Location: Global, fully remote
Job Type: Contractor (~15 hours per week)
Schedule: Flexible-you can choose the hours and days you work, including weekends if desired
We are looking for a highly skilled Aerodynamics Expert to contribute to an AI training project involving computational fluid dynamics, aerodynamic analysis, engineering simulation, and Python.
The work involves creating, solving, reviewing, and validating engineering tasks that can be completed through programmatic, command-line-based workflows. A representative task may require analyzing an airfoil, preparing a computational domain and mesh, defining appropriate boundary conditions, running a CFD simulation, calculating lift and drag, and determining whether the resulting flow field is numerically and physically valid.
What You’ll Work On

• Solve and validate aerodynamic and fluid-dynamics problems.

• Translate physical requirements into computational models and solver-ready cases.

• Create or modify geometries, computational domains, and meshes.

• Define appropriate initial conditions, boundary conditions, fluid properties, and solver settings.

• Run CFD and aerodynamic-analysis workflows using command-line-accessible tools.

• Use Python to automate preprocessing, simulation execution, parameter sweeps, postprocessing, and validation.

Required Qualifications

• An MS or PhD in Aerospace Engineering, or Mechanical Engineering with an aerodynamics, fluid dynamics, or thermofluids specialization; or

• A BS in Aerospace or Mechanical Engineering plus at least 1-2 years of aero-specific professional or research experience.

• Strong understanding of fluid mechanics and applied aerodynamics.

• Experience formulating and executing CFD or aerodynamic analyses.

• Practical proficiency with Python .

• Experience with at least one engineering tool or library that can be operated through a CLI, scripting interface, configuration files, or programmatic API.

• Ability to select and justify modeling assumptions, boundary conditions, mesh strategies, and solver settings.

• Ability to diagnose non-convergence, unstable solutions, incorrect results, and physically invalid outputs.

• Ability to communicate technical reasoning and engineering trade-offs clearly.

Relevant tools may include Python, OpenFOAM, SU2, Gmsh, FEniCSx, Elmer, CalculiX, SciPy , or similar programmatic engineering software. Experience with an equivalent CLI-accessible tool is acceptable.
Relevant Python tools may include NumPy, SciPy, pandas, Matplotlib, Jupyter , solver APIs, mesh-processing libraries, or domain-specific scientific packages. No single library is mandatory.
Process

• Apply to the role and complete the screening questions.

• Complete an AI interview of approximately 30 minutes.

• Complete the hiring manager review.

Compensation Structure
Compensation is output-based. Experts are paid per task that meets the project specifications. The time required to complete each task may vary depending on the expert’s experience and workflow.
Minimum submission requirements apply.
Start Timeline & Availability

• We typically fill roles within 48 hours and are looking for experts who are ready to begin immediately. If selected, you will be expected to start your first task within 24-48 hours of completing onboarding.

title: Specialista/ka zákaznické péče s němčinou
description:
V Rohlíku je Customer Care jedním z důvodů, proč jsme love brand. Zákazníci nás pravidelně chválí na sociálních sítích - protože jsme rychlí, lidští a protože nám na nich opravdu záleží.

Jako Specialista/ka zákaznické péče s němčinou budeš v první linii téhle zkušenosti. Budeš pomáhat zákazníkům přes telefon, e-mail a chat, řešit i složitější situace (včetně těch, které AI zatím nezvládne), a postaráš se o to, aby každý kontakt skončil s pocitem, že zákazník byl vyslyšen a dostal skutečnou pomoc.

 

Proč je tahle role zajímavá

- Budeš reprezentovat značku známou špičkovým zákaznickým servisem - a každý den pomáhat nastavovat laťku.

- Budeš pracovat se skutečnými lidmi a reálnými situacemi - žádné čtení skriptů, ale opravdové řešení problémů.

- Čeká tě inbound i outbound komunikace, nejen odpovídání na dotazy.

- Přidáš se do týmu, který drží spolu a zakládá si na tom, že věci dělá pořádně.

- Hybridní režim: po zapracování (obvykle 1-2 měsíce) je možný home office - 3 dny v kanceláři, 2 dny Home Office.

 

Co tě u nás čeká

- Komunikace se zákazníky přes e-mail, telefon a chat (inbound i outbound)

- Řešení požadavků, jako jsou změny času doručení, adresy, úpravy položek nebo kontaktních údajů

- Pomoc zákazníkům ve chvíli, kdy se něco pokazí - opožděné objednávky, problémy s doručením, reklamace

- Koordinace s kurýry, aby objednávky dorazily úspěšně a včas

- Úzká spolupráce s dalšími týmy (Logistika, Nákup apod.), aby se problémy řešily rychle

- Poskytování přesných informací o produktech a službách

- Sbírání zákaznické zpětné vazby a její sdílení, abychom naše služby dál zlepšovali

- Možnost kompenzovat reklamace kredity v rámci daných pravidel

- Přispívání k dobré atmosféře v týmu - Customer Care je týmový sport

 

Co od tebe potřebujeme

- Zkušenost ze zákaznického servisu nebo jiné zákaznicky orientované role

- Němčina je nutnost (pokročilá úroveň) - psaná i mluvená

- Čeština/slovenština je nutnost

- Angličtina je výhodou / silným plusem - psaná i mluvená

- Silné komunikační schopnosti a přirozeně prozákaznický přístup

- Odolnost vůči stresu a schopnost klidně zvládat konfliktní situace

- Schopnost rychle se učit a pracovat se základními nástroji (Google Workspace)

- Umíš přemýšlet kreativně a hledat pro zákazníka to nejlepší možné řešení, i když situace není úplně standardní.

- Ochota pracovat na směny je nutná, role může zahrnovat i práci o víkendech.

 

Co z toho budeš mít

- Férovou odměnu - Dostaneš fixní mzdu a variabilní část. Dobrá práce si zaslouží jasné a férové uznání.

- Dobré jídlo každý den - Každý den si můžeš dát oběd zdarma a v kanceláři tě čeká čerstvé ovoce a zelenina. Protože dobré jídlo dělá dobrou práci.

- Život, nejen práce - Skutečná flexibilita - tři dny v kanceláři, 2 dny Home Office. A ano, máme i neomezenou placenou dovolenou založenou na důvěře.

- Osobní růst - Porosteš stejně rychle jako Rohlík. Každá výzva je příležitost naučit se něco nového a zanechat stopu.

- Reálný dopad - To, co děláš, má smysl. Uvidíš, jak tvoje práce mění způsob, jakým lidé jedí a žijí - od prvního dne.

- Uznání mezi kolegy - Tvoje úsilí nezůstane bez povšimnutí. Můžeš ocenit ostatní (a být oceněn) díky peer kreditům, které využiješ v naší interní „kavárně“.

- Xtra členství - Získáš členství Xtra zdarma a 10% cashback na všechny nákupy na Rohlik.cz http://Rohlik.cz.

About the Role

Nubank is seeking a Staff Security Engineer to contribute in the Identity and Access Management security function across a financial technology organization serving over 100 million customers in Brazil, Mexico, and Colombia.
This is a senior individual-contributor role with organizational-level technical influence, responsible for supporting a multi-year IAM security strategy, directing its execution across multiple engineering teams, and ensuring that identity and access controls meet the security, regulatory, and operational requirements of a globally operating financial institution.

The Staff Security Engineer is expected to bring a demonstrated history of delivering consequential security programs - including programs that encountered setbacks - and the technical judgment that only sustained, hands-on experience in the domain produces.
Critically, this role requires a security engineering philosophy grounded in business enablement: the conviction that security done well accelerates what the organization can do, not merely protects it. This means rigorously distinguishing between controls that reduce real risk and those that create the appearance of compliance without reducing exposure, taking genuine ownership of outcomes rather than delegating accountability through policy, and continuously questioning inherited assumptions about what security measures are necessary, sufficient, or proportionate.

What You’ll Be Responsible For

- Defining, communicating, and executing a multi-year security strategy (especially in the IAM field) aligned with the organization's risk posture, regulatory obligations, and business objectives across multiple countries and regulatory jurisdictions.

- Lead organization-wide authentication migrations that span heterogeneous surfaces - browser, operating system login, CLI tooling, and API-level integrations - across thousands of employees, multiple device ecosystems, and distributed work environments, producing measurable outcomes: authentication success rates above 99%, material reductions in per-authentication time, support exception rates below 1%, and return on investment within weeks of enforcement.

- Designing and maintaining the core identity infrastructure with the durability and operational discipline required at organizational scale: enterprise Identity Provider, PKI and X.509 certificate lifecycle automation, mutual TLS for service-to-service authentication, and credential management systems engineered to remain sound as the organization grows.

- Translating least-privilege access from a principle into a measurable, organization-wide program - with defined metrics, visible adoption curves, and accountability structures that allow Security and Engineering leadership to track and act on the organization's access risk posture over time.

- Designing and maintaining a security engineering framework - comprising technical mechanisms, policies, incentives, and assurance processes - that ensures security properties are durable, verifiable, and operationally sound, rather than dependent on individual vigilance or periodic audits.

- Leading technical incident response for identity and access security events, including critical vulnerabilities in remote access infrastructure, ensuring thorough investigation, documented root cause analysis, and structural improvements that reduce the likelihood and impact of recurrence.

title: Senior Delivery Manager, Data & Models

Mission Lane is combining the power of data, technology, and exceptional service to pave a clear way forward for millions of people on the path to financial success. By attracting top talent and leveraging cutting-edge technology, we’re enabling people to unlock real financial progress. Sound like a mission you can get behind?

We’re looking for a Senior Delivery Manager, Data & Models to own delivery across Mission Lane ’s data and modeling work, from intake through deployment and ongoing maintenance, reporting to the Senior Director, Portfolio Prioritization & Delivery.
The impact you’ll make:
A customer opens the app and finds a credit line that has grown, a decision that came back quickly, or a next step explained in plain language. Behind each of those moments is data that is trusted and available, and often a model that has been built, validated, and approved to use it.
The Senior Delivery Manager, Data & Models shapes how that work gets planned, sequenced, and delivered. Data platforms, pipelines, and products feed nearly everything we do, and models are one of the highest-stakes things built on top of them. Every initiative crosses data engineering, data science, credit, risk, and compliance, and each group works to its own rhythm and its own standards. Your puzzle is sequencing that work so the right things ship in the right order, with governance built in rather than bolted on, keeping speed and rigor in balance.
Mission Lane is standing up a dedicated delivery team, and you will set the standard for how data and model work gets delivered. The teams you work with will run on a delivery approach you build and shape.
What you’ll own:

• The delivery roadmap for data and model initiatives across all business verticals, including milestones, dependencies, and sequencing, built with the portfolio prioritization team

• A single, current view of every data and model initiative in flight, with status, risks, and next steps shared with leaders and partner teams on a regular cadence

• Coordination across data engineering, data science, credit, risk, and compliance, with dependencies and unknowns surfaced early and cross-team problems driven to a solution

• The delivery playbook for model development, validation, deployment, credit policy updates, and related approval flows, with clear handoff ownership at every stage

• Model governance readiness, so models arrive at review complete and approvals don’t become a surprise bottleneck

• Delivery practices for data work such as pipeline and platform changes, data product releases, and data quality remediation, with the same clarity on ownership and handoffs

• Operational point of contact responsibilities for 2nd line credit and model risk management bank oversight

• Continuous improvement of how we plan and deliver, using delivery data and retrospectives to reduce coordination overhead and rework

• Informal guidance for less experienced delivery colleagues as delivery practice takes shape

You’ll thrive in this role if:

• You see delivery risk early. You notice the missing data dependency, the skipped validation step, or the sequencing conflict, trace it to its source, and bring a recommendation to the table.

• You are at home in data-heavy work and understand how data quality, lineage, and availability shape what can ship and when. You know how models are built, validated, governed, and deployed well enough to plan around the work and discuss it credibly with the data scientists, credit partners, and model risk reviewers who do it every day.

• You lead across teams you don’t manage. You build trust early, bring teams to a plan everyone understands, and explain the “why” behind new ways of working so teams adopt them and keep using them.

• You make sound sequencing and priority calls as the picture develops.

• You communicate with precision: clear plans, clear status, clear escalation, and no ambiguity about who owns what or what happens next.

• You share what you know

Here’s what this particular role covers.

Our Data Enrichment team builds the ground-truth datasets and classifiers that describe complex driving scenes across Wayve's data corpus. Drawing on Wayve's World Foundation Model, we help teams find rare scenarios, expose performance gaps and develop better perception and driving models, supporting the safety and reliability of Wayve's ADAS and AI Driver products. As a Machine Learning Engineer, Data Enrichment, you will tackle computer vision problems spanning road geometry, spatial relationships, road users and driving behaviour.

 

🧠 Your day-to-day

• Work with internal customers to define scene and scenario attributes, dataset requirements and measurable acceptance criteria for annotations and classifiers

• Design and refine annotation tasks and labelling instructions, using pilots, annotator agreement and expert review to resolve ambiguity and measure quality

• Curate and deliver ground-truth datasets for other teams to train and evaluate models, addressing rare scenarios, class imbalance and coverage across countries and vehicle platforms

• Build and evaluate computer vision models that draw on Wayve's World Foundation Model to identify scene attributes and driving behaviours

• Use error analysis to identify gaps in data, labels and model performance, and test approaches to improve them

 

🧩 What you’ll be working on

• Ground-truth datasets and classifiers that describe road geometry, spatial relationships, road users and driving behaviour

• Improving reusable tools for annotation, training, evaluation and inference

• Documenting dataset and classifier quality, and communicating limitations to colleagues across disciplines

• You have practical experience developing and evaluating computer vision models for image or video understanding, including interpreting spatial relationships in visual data

• You have strong Python programming skills and experience with a modern machine learning framework such as PyTorch

• You have experience curating training and evaluation datasets and assessing annotation quality, with an understanding of class imbalance, data leakage and representative evaluation

• You have taken machine learning models beyond experimentation into use, with reproducible training, evaluation and inference

• You can investigate model failures and determine whether improvements need better data, clearer labels or changes to the modelling approach

• You can translate an ambiguous customer request into clear technical deliverables and quality criteria, and communicate performance and limitations to colleagues from different disciplines

• Desirable: experience with 3D geometry, multi-camera systems or temporal scene understanding; autonomous driving, ADAS or robotics; adapting pretrained, foundation or vision-language models; human annotation workflows, active learning or model-assisted labelling; SQL, distributed data processing and batch inference

title: Senior+ Software Engineer - Integrations Platform
description:
The Role
Healthcare data is fragmented by default. Every provider, payer, EHR, referral source, and clinical system speaks a slightly different language. For Frontera to scale, both as a care delivery organization and as a technology platform, that fragmentation has to disappear behind a reliable, extensible integration and data layer.
As a Senior+ Software Engineer on our Integrations Platform, you'll be the technical lead for that layer, owning it end-to-end.
This role sits within our ML & Data organization because we don't view integrations as implementation plumbing. The systems we connect determine what data Frontera can access, how cleanly we can understand it, and ultimately what our product and AI systems can do with it. Every integration expands the number of organizations Frontera can work with, and adds breadth, fidelity, and context to the clinical data underlying the platform. That is the same longitudinal dataset that comes from operating real care alongside our own platform, not abstract transaction data.
This is a hands-on role. You'll spend roughly 70% of your time building, deep in the code and shaping architecture decisions, and the remainder working across Product, Clinical Operations, ML/Data, and external partners to make sure we're solving the right problems. You'll be the engineering owner for integrations from day one. Managing people is not a requirement at the start, but as integration volume and complexity grow, there's a clear path to growing the team and stepping into formal lead responsibilities.
What You'll Do

• Act as the tech lead for integrations, with end-to-end ownership of discovery, data mapping, implementation, reliability, observability, and long-term maintainability

• Own the integration architecture: design how Frontera connects with external healthcare systems (EHRs, partners, and other data sources), establishing reusable patterns and tooling rather than one-off builds for each new organization

• Identify which problems are worth solving, not just solve the ones you're assigned. You'll help define the right answer where the specification doesn't yet exist, working directly with external technical teams and internal stakeholders

• Bring an AI-informed lens to the work itself: use agentic tooling to accelerate data mapping and schema discovery across new partner systems, rather than treating each integration as a fully manual build. Judgment on when to automate discovery versus handle a partner's edge cases by hand is part of the craft

• Shape the unified data model underneath those integrations, in close partnership with ML/Data, Product, Engineering, and Clinical Operations

• Set clear standards for data quality, error handling, monitoring, and operational ownership as integration volume grows

• Help determine what should become platform capability versus what should be solved pragmatically for a specific partner or workflow

• Raise the technical bar for the team by mentoring engineers, setting working norms, and contributing to hiring as the function scales

Why This Matters
Better integrations mean faster onboarding of new organizations, less operational friction for clinicians and teams, and a more complete view of the care journey. They also improve the quality and usefulness of the data Frontera can learn from, because we operate care directly and that data reflects real clinical workflows and outcomes. As that dataset grows, it becomes increasingly important to how we evaluate care models, build AI systems, improve workflows, and differentiate the platform. This role is one of the foundational technical layers behind that scale strategy.
Qualifications

• 6+ years of experience in backend-leaning software engineering, with strong experience building APIs, integration systems, or distributed backend services

• Track record of owning technically complex projects end-to-end, with ownership that extends beyond your own lane

• Experience building and scaling integration p

title: Sr. Director, VAR & Channel Partnerships
description:
As Sr. Director, VAR & Channel Partnerships at vCluster Labs, you aren’t just signing reseller agreements; you are building and leading the global partner channel that lets the world’s AI infrastructure resellers sell tenant isolation without us in the room.

Enterprises do not buy AI infrastructure one product at a time. They buy it from the reseller who already holds the paper, the services capacity, and the trust. Your first targets are the partners where our path to the money is right now: WWT and Computacenter, then SHI, CDW, and the national and regional VARs that actually sell AI infrastructure. You can pull in distributors, and the OEM and ISV partners your peers own, where they accelerate a deal; the global system integrators (Accenture, Deloitte, EY) stay with the VP.

This is a founding, zero-to-one role on a first-year partner program. You start as an individual contributor: there is no channel to inherit, and you will carry the first partners and the first number yourself. As the channel proves out, you will hire and lead the team that scales it globally. Success is measured in partner-sourced bookings, transacting partners, and registered deals that close. Not in logos signed.

As Sr. Director, VAR & Channel Partnerships, your role will include:

- Global partner leadership: You will own vCluster’s global VAR and channel partnerships end to end: the strategy, the executive relationships, and the commercial results. You will be vCluster’s senior voice with partner leadership across North America, EMEA, and APJ, and you will decide where we invest and where we do not.

- Recruitment and activation: You will recruit against a filter, not for coverage. A short list of VARs who can actually source AI infrastructure and platform engineering deals beats a long list who cannot. You will own the path from first conversation to first transaction: agreement, track admission, enablement, first registered deal, and first close. You will also retire non-performing partners without drama. Time from signature to first dollar is your headline metric.

- Transaction mechanics: You will own the partner commercial model: tier discounts, deal-registration uplift, renewal margin, volume incentives, and named-account bonuses. You will run deal registration and Partner of Record, including regional PoR, active-engagement standards, renewal rights, and conflict resolution that holds up when two partners claim the same account. You will build distribution where it scales the motion, while keeping the quoting and order path clean enough that partners do not route around it.

- Field alignment: You will make co-sell comp-neutral so our sellers get full quota credit and never fight the channel. You will build named-account maps between vCluster sellers and partner sellers, with deal registration the field trusts. You will give partner sellers a reason to lead with vCluster: margin they can count on, services attach they can sell, and a technical story their SEs can carry.

- Multi-party plays with the ecosystem: You will connect VAR opportunities to the NVIDIA alliance and the OEM and ISV design wins your peers land, so a WWT or Computacenter seller can quote a validated stack with vCluster already inside it. Where a distributor accelerates a deal, you bring them in.

- Enablement, marketing, and MDF: You will own sales and technical certification for your partners and hold the tier requirements. You will run joint marketing with pipeline objectives attached: field events, webinars, named-account campaigns, and customer stories. You will approve MDF against pipeline outcomes and enforce proof of performance. Discretionary spend earns its return or it stops.

- Building the team: You will design the channel organization: the roles, the hiring sequence, and the coverage model by region and partner tier. As partner revenue grows, you will hire and lead partner managers and partner engineers, starting with the roles that unlock the most revenue.

title: Senior Infrastructure Automation Engineer, Compute Platform - EDA Infrastructure
description:
Managing twenty-five scheduler cells by hand does not scale, and we are not going to try. NVIDIA is building a config-as-code foundation for its EDA compute farm, and we need an automation engineer to own it end to end. You are joining at the point where this is still partially manual and inconsistently applied across cells. That is the interesting version of the problem - you will be migrating off partial systems and reconciling drift, not starting from a blank repository.
What you'll be doing:

• Designing and owning the configuration schema for LSF cell deployment, so that a policy change is written once, reviewed, tested, and applied identically everywhere it belongs.

• Building the deployment pipeline that takes scheduler configuration from merge to production across a federated estate, including staged rollout and rollback.

• Eliminating configuration drift across cells, and building the tooling that keeps it eliminated.

• Standing up the regression suite that lets us upgrade LSF on a schedule rather than on a dare.

• Working alongside our LSF internals engineer to encode hard-won scheduler knowledge into templates and policy, so that expertise lives in the repository instead of in one person's head.

What we need to see:

• BS or MS in Computer Science or equivalent experience.

• 6+ years in infrastructure engineering with strong config management depth - Ansible, Salt, Puppet, Chef, or comparable.

• Real experience with GitOps practice at scale: review workflow, environment promotion, drift detection, and safe rollback.

• Proficiency in Go, Python and shell, and comfort building the tooling rather than only using it.

• Experience automating stateful, long-lived infrastructure where you cannot simply destroy and recreate.

Ways to stand out from the crowd:

• You have brought a manually administered estate under configuration management while it stayed in production.

• Familiarity with LSF, Slurm, or another batch scheduler as a configuration target.

• CI/CD experience for infrastructure, including test environments that meaningfully resemble production.

• Observability instincts - you instrument what you automate.

Your base salary will be determined based on your location, experience, and the pay of employees in similar positions. The base salary range is 184,000 USD - 287,500 USD for Level 4, and 224,000 USD - 356,500 USD for Level 5. You will also be eligible for equity and benefits.

We integrate, launch, and operate spacecraft, offering end-to-end missions as a service across Earth observation, IoT connectivity, on-orbit AI, national security missions, and more. Leveraging our existing space infrastructure and an extensive inventory of satellite buses, Loft is reducing years-long integration and launch timelines to months. With more than 30 missions flown, Loft’s flight heritage and proven technologies enable customers to focus on their mission objectives.

With a growing fleet on track to reach 30 satellites by 2027, we are scaling up quickly across our offices in San Francisco, CA | Golden, CO | and Toulouse, France to meet accelerating demand for space infrastructure.

As an international company your resume will be reviewed by people across our offices so please attach a copy in English.

description:
Description
CapsLock is a global IT marketing company that pioneers unique, scalable customer acquisition solutions for B2C clients. We solve complex sales challenges across a wide range of industries, primarily for large North American partners. By integrating our expertise in Digital Marketing, IT, Design, AI-driven analytics, proprietary MarTech, and sales consulting, we deliver powerful, data-informed customer acquisition solutions.
At CapsLock , people, technology, and forward-thinking innovation lie at the heart of everything we do. Our diverse, global team, fluent in over 10 languages, thrives on open collaboration and the exchange of new ideas, pushing boundaries to ensure our clients' success.
﻿Role overview
Our creative team produces hundreds of video ads, images and ad copy variations every month, and we test them across our campaigns to find out what works best. Behind all of that is a fast-moving pipeline, and we’re looking for a Creative Marketing Project Coordinator to keep it running smoothly.
You’ll be working with a team of 15-25 creative strategists, video editors, designers and media buyers. You’ll turn ideas and requests into clear tasks, keep everyone aligned on deadlines, review the final work before it goes live, and make sure every asset gets launched and tested. Many of our workflows are already automated, and we’d love someone who enjoys finding smarter ways to work as we grow.
If you love bringing order to a busy environment, have a sharp eye for detail and are curious about the creative side of marketing, this role is a great place to grow. You’ll also be invited to brainstorming sessions and can contribute your own ideas to the creative process.
Responsibilities
Task & Pipeline Management

• Turn monthly creative requests (videos, images and ad copy) into clear, well-structured tasks in ClickUp (our project management system).

• Add briefs, guidelines and references to each task, and assign it to the right team member

• Agree on deadlines with each team and track every task from request to launch

• Keep an accurate record of all creative tests and their status at every stage

Cross-Team Coordination & Follow-Up

• Communicate daily with a team of 15-25 creative strategists, video editors, designers and media buyers

• Follow up proactively so deadlines are met and nothing stalls in the pipeline

• Flag delays and bottlenecks early and help resolve them

• Release approved assets to media buyers and confirm they have been received, launched and reviewed

Quality Control

• Review final images, videos and ad copy before launch against briefs, client guidelines and technical specifications

• Catch typos, formatting errors and visual glitches before assets go live

• Develop an eye for visual inconsistencies, such as AI-generated artifacts, distorted details or elements that don’t make sense in context

• Collaborate with team members on final reviews and approvals

Reporting & Documentation

• Maintain structured logs of what is live, what is in testing and what has been learned

• Prepare clear status updates and reports using automated data and AI tools

• Document all tasks clearly in ClickUp per team standards

Process Improvement & AI

• Identify repetitive work and use AI tools and automations to streamline the workflow

• Help scale the pipeline to handle 100-350 tasks per month without losing accuracy

• Suggest improvements to task structure, templates and handoff processes

Creative Collaboration

• Take part in team brainstorming sessions and contribute ideas

• Turn raw concepts from brainstorms into structured, actionable tasks

• Build an understanding of our creative work and what performs well, with room to grow into the creative side over time

Requirements
Must-Have Skills

• Proven ability to manage a high volume of tasks with strict deadlines and accurate tracking

• Ability to turn requests and ideas into clear, structured tasks

• Confidence in following up with many people

title: Staff / Principal Applied AI Researcher (Agentic Search)
description:
About Nebius :

Nebius is leading a new era in cloud infrastructure for the global AI economy. We are building a full-stack AI cloud platform that supports developers and enterprises from data and model training through to production deployment, without the cost and complexity of building large in-house AI/ML infrastructure.

Built by engineers, for engineers. From large-scale GPU orchestration to inference optimization, we own the hard problems across compute, storage, networking and applied AI.

Listed on Nasdaq (NBIS) and headquartered in Amsterdam, we have a global footprint with R&D hubs across Europe, the UK, North America and Israel. Our team of 1,500+ includes hundreds of engineers with deep expertise across hardware, software and AI R&D.

We are seeking a Staff or Principal Applied AI Researcher to join a fast growing team building an agent native search platform - the web access layer for AI systems.
You can think of this as Google for AI agents: a system designed for machines, not humans. We are building agentic search, where AI systems actively plan, retrieve, evaluate, and refine information rather than simply returning results. As AI becomes the primary interface to the web, this layer will replace the role of traditional search engines.
We are designing how AI agents - not humans - retrieve, evaluate, and reason over web data in real time, under strict latency and reliability constraints. This means solving retrieval and ranking under entirely new access patterns and at significant scale, with systems operating over constantly changing, unstructured data and serving tens of thousands of production workloads 24 by 7.
This role comes with ownership over key parts of our applied AI research direction and system design, with a strong expectation of defining new approaches and shipping measurable impact in production.
What you'll work on:

• Designing agent native retrieval systems optimised for machine consumption rather than human search UX

• Building systems where LLMs iteratively plan, query, refine, and reason over results

• Developing ranking and retrieval approaches for multi step, agent driven workflows under real world constraints

Your responsibilites:

• Drive applied research and technical direction across retrieval and ranking systems

• Design and evolve multi stage retrieval architectures (query understanding, rewriting, reranking, iterative retrieval)

• Develop methods for grounding LLMs in real time web data at scale

• Define and implement new evaluation paradigms and metrics for agentic systems, where correctness is not reducible to clicks

• Lead experimentation on modern retrieval approaches (embeddings, hybrid search, reranking) and bring them into production

• Analyse trade-offs across relevance, latency, and cost at scale

• Work closely with engineering to deploy systems in high throughput, low latency environments

• Own ambiguous problems end to end and contribute to product and research direction

• Mentor engineers and help raise the technical bar of the team

Must haves:

• Deep experience with search, retrieval, ranking, recommendation systems, or assistants

• Strong understanding of modern deep learning, especially transformers and embeddings

• Experience with LLM integrated or knowledge intensive systems

• Ability to operate in a fast moving, product driven environment with high ownership and autonomy

Nice to haves

• Background in agentic AI systems (agents, tool use, autonomous workflows)

• Experience with RAG, multi step retrieval, or tool use

We're hiring a solutions lead to own the technical side of every International deal over 15 locations. Your demos and labs are where our deals are won or lost.

Location: Preference EST timezone to support International markets 

A day in the life (Responsibilities)

• Run demos that win the room. Build every demo from discovery. Show a 40-site group their own menu, their own workflows and the systems they already run, in their market's version of the product. Tailor it to each person in the buying group, from the head of ops to the IT lead to finance. Leave each of them with a reason to champion Toast.

• Run labs that end in a decision. Agree success criteria with the customer before the lab starts. Build and maintain the lab environment, track every issue, drive escalations and root cause analysis, and close the lab with a clear yes or no. No lab ends without an agreed next step.

• Own the technical outcome through go-live. The deal isn't won until the customer is live and it matches what we sold. Stay involved through procurement and handoff.

All of it within what's actually available, and what payments rules allow, in each market.

• Lead security, IT and compliance reviews. Own vendor security questionnaires, PCI scoping conversations and the technical sections of RFPs.

• Speak product's language. Write business requirement documentation that product and engineering can act on: the problem, the customer's own words, workarounds tried, what's at stake across the segment (not just one account), and options with tradeoffs. • Sell outcomes, not features. Partner with sales to build the business case. Translate technical fit into the outcomes the economic buyer cares about, such as labor, speed of service and revenue. • Build real relationships outside the sales thread. Become the trusted counterpart to the customer's IT lead, head of operations and systems owners, relationships that hold up on their own merit.

• Partner across Solutions. Work closely with the International SMB Solutions team on clear lanes, shared tools and cross-coverage.

• Grow the team. Help define, hire and develop the International upmarket solutions team as the business scales.

• Own your own leverage. Continuously find the repetitive parts of the role (RFP answers, security questionnaires, discovery notes, demo resets) and systematically get them off your plate.

• Close the loop on what's broken. Feed product gaps, lost-deal reasons and market differences back to product and sales leadership, so the next deal is easier than the last.

title: Senior Economist
description:
Relay is fundamentally reshaping how goods move in an online era. Backed by Europe’s largest-ever logistics Series A ($35M) led by deep-tech investors Plural, and a recently closed Series B ($95M), Relay is scaling faster than 99% of venture-backed startups. We're assembling the most talent-dense team the logistics industry has ever seen

Relay’s Mission is to free commerce from friction. Today, high delivery costs act as a hidden tax on e-commerce, quietly shaping what can be sold online and limiting who can participate. We envision a world where more goods move more freely between more people, making the online shopping experience seamless and accessible to everyone.

THE TEAM
• ~160 people, around half in engineering, product and data
• 45+ advanced degrees across computer science, mathematics and operations research
• Thousands of data points captured, calculated, analysed and predicted for every single parcel we handle
• An intellectually vibrant culture of first‑principles thinking, tight feedback loops and relentless experimentation

Relay is a marketplace for delivery work. Every day, 400,000 parcels move through our network, carried by couriers who choose when and how they work, across four marketplaces, each with its own app and its own economics.

When we offer a courier work, the price is part of the offer. Price it too low and routes go unserved; price it too high and the network pays for capacity it didn't need. Science at Relay brings operational research, machine learning, causal inference and economics together to optimise the whole network rather than one decision at a time. Economics decides what the work is worth.

MARKETPLACE HIGHLIGHTS

- Four marketplaces, four apps, each with its own economics.

- A live, two-sided marketplace where couriers choose their work, with every decision logged across millions of parcels.

- Interference between couriers, heterogeneous effects and long-run behaviour are the norm, not the exception.

- Prices sit inside recommendations and network-wide optimisation, so economics, personalisation and operational research have to work as one.

THE OPPORTUNITY

As a Senior Economist at Relay, you'll:

- Own courier pricing and pay policy: how work is priced, how couriers are paid, and how incentives are set across our marketplaces.

- Apply economic theory to a live marketplace: model supply, demand and courier behaviour, and design pricing and incentive mechanisms that hold up in the real network.

- Measure what every pricing and pay change did, working with our Applied Scientists and experimenting across a live two-sided marketplace.

- Partner with Operational Research and Recommender Systems so price is set as part of the recommendation, not after it.

- Advise leadership on pricing and incentives, and help build Relay's research culture and voice in the tech community.

WE'RE LOOKING FOR CANDIDATES WHO…

- Have a PhD in economics, and have applied it in a tech marketplace such as ride-hailing, delivery or a gig platform.

- Have advised leadership on pricing or incentive decisions, and seen those decisions through to what happened next.

- Are deeply skilled in econometrics and causal inference, and know how to apply economic theory to a real marketplace, not just a model of one.

- Are hands-on: you write the code, run the analysis and build the models yourself.

- Explain economics clearly to operations, product and leadership, without the jargon.

Who Thrives at Relay?

- Aim with Precision: You define problems clearly and measure your impact meticulously.

- Play to Win: You chase bold bets, tackle the hard stuff, and view constraints as fuel, not friction.

- 1% Better Every Day: You believe that small, consistent improvements lead to exponential growth. You move quickly, deliver results, and learn from every experience.

- All In, All the Time: You show up and step up. You take ownership from start to finish and do what it takes to deliver when it counts.

- People-Powe

title: Senior Oracle EBS Developer / Integration Architect
description:
CompassX is a boutique business and technology consulting firm. We help Fortune 500 and high-growth clients deliver their most strategic initiatives, from enterprise transformations to digital and data-driven projects. With over 15 years of proven results, we’ve expanded across industries including financial services, pharmaceuticals, aerospace, consumer products, and quick service restaurants.
We are honored to be recognized as a three-time winner of Consulting Magazine’s Best Boutique Firms to Work For, and previously recognized as a “Best Place to Work” in Southern California and one of INC.’s 5000 fastest-growing private companies in the U.S.
CompassX is partnering with an enterprise client to support a fast-moving AI-driven initiative connecting their Oracle E-Business Suite environment to a broader integration and applications ecosystem. This is a chance to work at the architecture and development level on a genuinely complex problem for an organization that's investing seriously in modernizing how its core ERP talks to the rest of its new applications and technology stack.
What You'll Do

• Design and build a common data-services layer that connects multiple, differently-configured Oracle EBS instances across regions - reconciling real differences between environments rather than treating them as identical

• Expose EBS data through integrations and APIs to other systems, with a particular focus on Manufacturing, Inventory, and Item Master data

• Work hands-on with PL/SQL, EBS Open Interfaces, and standard APIs - this is a build role, not a configuration role

• Partner directly with other developers and technical stakeholders as a peer - you'll be the one they come to with questions about the SQL and architecture, not someone translating between business and engineering

• Bring an architect's perspective to the work: looking across distinct systems, spotting where approaches diverge, and designing a solution that holds up across all of them rather than solving for just one environment

• Act as a trusted technical voice in a still-evolving initiative - this program is actively taking shape, and there's real room to help define how the work gets scoped and delivered, not just execute against a fixed spec

What You'll Bring

• Strong experience working as a true consultant to your stakeholders and clients

• Deep, hands-on Oracle EBS technical development experience - strong PL/SQL, EBS Open Interfaces and standard APIs, and concurrent program load mechanisms

• Experience with Oracle Integration Cloud (OIC) and/or SOA, plus REST/SOAP web services

• Working knowledge of EBS data models for Manufacturing/BOM, Inventory, and Item Master - direct experience with the Item/PTM table is especially valuable

• Experience working across multiple EBS instances, ideally having reconciled differently-configured environments

• A technical/integration mindset over a functional/configuration one - comfortable going deep on code and architecture, not just gathering requirements

• Comfort operating with some ambiguity - this is an early-stage initiative, and part of the value you bring is helping shape the approach alongside the team, not just following one that's already fully defined

• Bonus if familiarity with Oracle PD Cloud (Oracle PLM)

Our consultants say CompassX is a place where they can truly find their own path. As part of a smaller firm, they see the impact of their work, have an identity, and know their voice matters. They value the freedom to take the reins of their careers, shape their client work, and maintain a direct line to leadership.
With CompassX’s focus on serving local Southern California clients, consultants not only build lasting relationships but also see the results of their work in the communities where they live.
At CompassX, you won’t just follow a path - you’ll create one.

description:
Treat PeteDME’s MSK Integrated Care patients from home. Our program pairs knee and lumbar bracing with physical therapy and remote therapeutic monitoring, delivered through a network of in-home therapists. Remote visits and monitoring are paid per visit and per call.

How you join
Every therapist on the remote caseload starts with six in-person brace fittings on patients from your own current caseload, so you know the devices you will be coaching patients on. Teletherapy patient referrals from PeteDME begin: our patients, work from home, on your schedule, paid per visit and per call.

• Free specialized training and certification in orthopedic bracing.
• AI-generated SOAP notes - no new EMR to learn.
• Keep your current job. This is additional, independent-contractor work alongside it.
• Flat fees fixed in advance; no part of your pay depends on volume or on referrals.
Requirements
• Active physical therapist or physical therapist assistant license in the state where you practice.
• Currently working in home health or another in-home setting.
• You evaluate and provide treatment.

How to apply
Complete the short questionnaire. It asks about your license, your setting, and your caseload, and it asks you to acknowledge that teletherapy referrals begin after six fittings. A clinical onboarding specialist will reach out within one business day.

title: Director, Performance Marketing
locationText: New York, New York, United States
description:
CLEAR is building THE secure identity company of the future. Our mission is to make experiences safer and easier-physically and digitally. With more than 43 million Members and a growing network of partners across the world, CLEAR's secure identity platform is transforming the way people live, work, and travel. Whether it’s at the airport, stadium, or throughout your everyday life, CLEAR unlocks the magic of frictionless experiences.

The Director, Performance Marketing will own CLEAR’s paid customer acquisition engine, driving efficient, scalable growth in new Member bookings across paid media, search, and emerging discovery channels. As AI reshapes how travelers discover, evaluate, and purchase products, you’ll define the next generation of CLEAR’s paid acquisition playbook, reaching travelers long before they arrive at the airport and turning them into long-term Members.

 

What you'll do:

• Own CLEAR’s paid acquisition strategy and media investment portfolio across paid search, paid social, programmatic, video/CTV, affiliate, and emerging channels, allocating budget based on incrementality, customer economics, and measurable business impact.

• Build and optimize CLEAR’s paid presence across traditional search and emerging AI-driven discovery surfaces (AI assistants, travel media, communities, and new ad platforms), and establish how we measure and grow paid visibility and performance as consumer behavior evolves.

• Build a rigorous experimentation and measurement engine for paid media, owning CAC, LTV:CAC, payback, incrementality, and portfolio ROI, using holdouts, geo tests, MMM, and attribution to guide investment decisions.

• Drive continuous improvement through creative testing, audience strategy, bidding and budget automation, and AI-enabled tools, partnering with Creative, Analytics, Product, and Engineering on landing page and conversion testing for paid traffic.

• Manage agency and platform relationships, forecast and pace spend, and report on performance to senior leadership.

 

How you'll measure success:

• Growth in new Member bookings through paid digital channels.

• Improvement in blended and channel-level CAC, payback period, LTV:CAC, and paid media ROI.

• Share of spend with validated incrementality, and speed and quality of the testing roadmap.

• Growth in CLEAR’s paid visibility and performance across traditional and AI-driven discovery.

 

What you're great at:

• 8+ years of performance marketing experience, including ownership of paid acquisition within a scaled subscription, membership, or consumer business, with 2+ years in a leadership capacity.

• Deep analytical fluency and command of growth economics: you’ve built and used LTV:CAC models, designed incrementality experiments and holdouts, and can work directly with SQL and BI tools to make investment decisions.

• Hands-on expertise across paid media platforms (Google, Meta, programmatic, CTV, affiliate), measurement and attribution tools, and experimentation frameworks; you can move seamlessly between setting strategy and getting into the details of execution.

• A strong point of view on how AI is changing consumer discovery and paid media, with demonstrated experience applying emerging technology to improve performance, creative development, audience strategy, or measurement.

• A builder and owner who thrives in lean, fast-moving environments: you develop exceptional talent, move quickly from insight to action, and are comfortable personally doing the work when that is what it takes to deliver the outcome.

 

How You'll be Rewarded:

At CLEAR, we help YOU move forward - because when you’re at your best, we’re at our best. You’ll work with talented team members motivated by our mission of making experiences safer and easier. Our offices are bright and energetic with an open concept and plenty of conference rooms and casual co-working spaces. We also offer catered lunches every day and have fully stocked kitchens.

We’re looking for a German-speaking Project Manager to join our Implementation team and run SINGU platform rollouts for international clients, many of them in German-speaking markets.

You’ll own projects from kickoff to go-live: planning, coordinating client and internal teams, keeping scope and timelines under control, and making sure clients end up with a platform they actually use. You’ll work in English and German every day.

You’ll be running real client projects from day one, not supporting someone else’s. You’ll work with international real estate clients and a team that values getting things done properly.

- Run client implementations end to end - from kickoff and requirements gathering through configuration, data migration, training and go-live.
